data.name: Stardust
data.description: As a standard action, the shaman causes stardust to materialize around one creature within 30 feet. This stardust causes the target to shed light as a candle, and it cannot benefit from concealment or any invisibility effects. The creature takes a %1 penalty on attack rolls and sight-based Perception checks. This effect lasts for %2 rounds level. Sightless creatures cannot be affected by this ability. The shaman can use this ability %3/day.|ShamanStardustPenalty|ShamanStardustDuration|ShamanStardustTimes
